content:
“Mutants unite!”— Perk card description

**Strange in Numbers** is a Charisma-based perk in *Fallout 76*.

Positive mutation effects are stronger if teammates are mutated too.

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★ | 1 | Positive mutation effects are +25% stronger if teammates are mutated too. | 003808D0 | 

The perk checks to see if the player is a member of a team and if there are any teammates that are mutated in order to take effect.

- Prior to patch 1.0.4.13, the increased effect of some mutations could sometimes be extremely significant if both mutated and non-mutated players were simultaneously on a team. For example, the Bird Bones mutation can cause the player's fall speed to be reduced so much that it is possible to walk in air.[1][2][3][4] [verified] 
- When remaining on an empty team after all other teammates go offline, all positive effects of mutations will be eliminated rather than restored to normal mutation levels. Unequipping and re-equipping the Strange in Numbers perk card will restore normal mutation levels. [verified]
